headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 20, 2026**
article:
The Minnesota Twins suffered a blowout loss to the Cleveland Guardians, who were led by Petey Halpin's 3-hit, 2-home-run performance. In other action, the New York Yankees secured a 5-8 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Jazz Chisholm Jr. hitting 2 home runs and Wilber Dotel pitching 3 scoreless innings.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Trevor McDonald, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right elbow strain with the San Francisco Giants. Other injured players include Garrett Stubbs (Philadelphia Phillies), Kyle Teel (Chicago White Sox), Zack Kelly (Boston Red Sox), Max Meyer (Miami Marlins), Phil Maton (Chicago Cubs), Miguel Andujar (San Diego Padres), and Adley Rutschman (Baltimore Orioles).

The Los Angeles Dodgers made a trade with the Colorado Rockies, acquiring Seth Halvorsen in exchange for Nick Frasso and Landyn Vidourek. The Chicago Cubs also made a trade, acquiring Aaron Civale from the Athletics in exchange for Aiden Moffett. Additionally, the Baltimore Orioles acquired Rudy Martin Jr. from the Kansas City Royals in a cash trade, and the St. Louis Cardinals acquired Trey Pooser from the Tampa Bay Rays.

top_news.title: **Twins Fall to Guardians in Blowout**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins suffered a 13-4 loss to the Cleveland Guardians, with the Guardians' offense dominating the game. Petey Halpin led the Guardians' charge with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall to Yankees in 8-5 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-8 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Jazz Chisholm Jr. leading the Pirates' offense with 2 home runs and 5 RBIs. Wilber Dotel pitched 3 scoreless innings for the Pirates, striking out 5 batters.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Blue Jays 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays. Nick Fortes led the Rays' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Edge Orioles in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 6-5 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, coming from behind to take the win. Christian Encarnacion-Strand led the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Shut Out by Yankees in Thrilling Match**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 0-0 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, marking a hard-fought win for the Yankees.

top_news.title: **Giants' Trevor McDonald Lands on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants right-handed pitcher Trevor McDonald has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right elbow strain.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Acquire Halvorsen in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers have acquired right-handed pitcher Seth Halvorsen in a trade with the Colorado Rockies. Halvorsen joins the Dodgers in exchange for right-handed pitcher Nick Frasso and outfielder Landyn Vidourek.
